headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving gains for several firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest (Infosys 1.5%) to very strong (Coforge 53.6%). Profit margins improved for most, aided by AI‑related deals. Guidance was trimmed by Infosys but raised by Coforge. Dividend payouts remained steady across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue expansion
themes.detail: Several companies reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting top‑line and profit.

themes.title: Margin and guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin guidance, while Infosys cut its FY27 revenue outlook.

themes.title: Dividend consistency
themes.detail: Most firms declared or maintained interim dividends, supporting shareholder returns.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
30.3% YoY revenue growth despite profit decline.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and guidance is flat.
